decisions.reason: The NFT-detail sizing confirmation is an independent observation already represented in this Requirement; changing the badge set and row layout does not alter NFT media rendering.
Removing Pathfinder from the presented badge set and changing its dashboard layout do not alter the referral thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment rules.
The badge presentation decision does not require any change to the approved FAQ copy or its badge topic coverage.
The invalid-code wording clause in the same message is independent of the badge presentation decision, which does not change referral eligibility or self-referral validation.
The source changes the dashboard badge arrangement, not the landing-page content or layout.
The badge set and row-layout changes do not affect landing-page book-cover placement, size, or cropping.
The badge presentation decision does not change the NFT token serial used as the referral code or any referral-code display location.
Dashboard badge presentation is unrelated to the PDF.js reader, its entry points, or book-view width.
The badge presentation change does not alter email authentication or authenticated dashboard access behavior.
The source governs the visible badge set and dashboard row layout; it does not require changing the existing metadata rule that permanent badges remain visible.
The badge presentation decision does not change which mints may be counted or represented as owned NFTs.
The badge set and dashboard layout changes do not alter email delivery, winner notifications, or mint-confirmation contents.
